surface_inventory.name: Jarvis Box runtime and onboarding surface
Customer skill installer and depth audit
Public overlay, provider loop, and delivery metrics

capabilities.task_family: Build a customer-derived Jarvis Box Docker image
trigger_examples: The customer repository needs compiler or shared-library packages absent from the base image
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Pinned base image -> customer image digest -> deployment pin -> executable probe; rollback uses the matching old release and digest.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: The trigger and proof are image-specific, but operation still shares release/version and deployment ownership with jarvis-box.
capabilities.reason: Current guide and release model agree on digest-pinned base and derived image.

trigger_examples: Change the default Agent, notification behavior, allowlists, tools, caches, or preparation hooks
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Resolve target -> identify owning file/CLI -> authorized narrow edit -> controlled activate/recreate -> effective-state and behavior proof.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: One general configuration workflow owns field selection and routes first-run/read-only adjacent work.
capabilities.reason: The current skill maps intent to fields and separates save from activation.

capabilities.task_family: Onboard or qualify a Jarvis Box deployment
trigger_examples: Decide whether this deployment is actually ready
Prove Agent discovery and provider delivery
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Version/identity preflight -> read-only deployment -> credentials and discovery -> authorized ingress -> Task/Run -> writeback -> terminal/cleanup.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Readiness is an independently requested outcome and must not be collapsed into generic configuration or read-only diagnosis.
capabilities.reason: Current onboarding guidance separates component evidence from the full delivery loop.

capabilities.task_family: Recover, continue, or cancel a Jarvis Box Task
trigger_examples: The user wants to stop current work
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Read server action policy; choose agent/recover/writeback Continue or Cancel; preserve Task identity, process ownership, workspace leases, and terminalization intent.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Recovery and cancellation share one Task lifecycle authority; Start/Continue/Cancel are the only public actions.
capabilities.reason: Current contract proves policy-driven strategy selection and process/lease safeguards.

capabilities.task_family: Run a customer-owned scheduled prompt job
trigger_examples: Fresh prompt Task on every firing
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Each firing starts a fresh Task with stable job id; same active job id conflicts; never repeatedly Continue an old Task.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Scheduled trigger is distinct, but it uses the same Task Start owner and is operationally coupled to task recovery.
capabilities.reason: Current contract defines lane/job identity and avoids recurring Continue.

capabilities.task_family: Configure customer-visible messages and provider intake
trigger_examples: Add a provider or repository allowlist
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Select exact fields -> preserve format slots and secrets -> save -> restart/recreate -> verify configured provider path.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Message/provider intent shares the configuration workflow but has distinct fields and proof, kept in one reference rather than competing skills.
capabilities.reason: Current references cover templates, identity separation, allowlists, and connector ownership.

capabilities.task_family: Handle uncertain or failed provider delivery
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Durable intake -> dispatch -> completed/failed/outcome_unknown; uncertain external effects must not be automatically replayed.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Uncertain side effects need a distinct idempotence policy even though they route through Task Continue.
capabilities.reason: The current receipt contract explicitly distinguishes accepted, completed, failed, and outcome_unknown.

capabilities.task_family: Choose and verify runtime identity and secret boundaries
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Select native/import/in-container identity path -> preserve narrow secret owners -> persist identity -> verify actual runtime capability; machine identity remains deployment-bound.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Identity is an onboarding prerequisite and security boundary; onboarding owns whether it is sufficient for the full loop.
capabilities.reason: Current docs agree on persistent Agent HOME and narrow import, but overlay identity prose still requires release-specific observation.

capabilities.task_family: Diagnose a Jarvis Box deployment without mutation
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Resolve target -> collect typed stage evidence -> distinguish health, license, Agent, ingress, execution, delivery, cleanup -> report next action without mutation.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Read-only diagnosis has a distinct trigger and mutability boundary from Act configuration/repair.
capabilities.reason: The current skill explicitly forbids mutations and separation of failure stages.

capabilities.task_family: Summarize recent activity and actionable blockers
entrypoints: status structured endpoints when observation is safe
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Declare window/population -> inspect blockers and selected details -> separate execution/delivery/cleanup -> report sampled counts and next actions without mutation.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Monitoring asks for a population summary and remains read-only; one-case diagnosis belongs to doctor.
capabilities.reason: The current skill distinguishes sampled monitoring, historical defaults, and metric boundaries.

capabilities.task_family: Resolve installed-release and public-documentation version compatibility
trigger_examples: Public main differs from the installed version
Choose release assets or an explicit version
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Identify installed version -> select matching release authorities -> reject cross-version assumptions -> apply only supported action or propose upgrade.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Version authority constrains all operations and is independently triggered by drift or unsupported commands.
capabilities.reason: Current release model distinguishes public overlay from private source and matching release assets.

capabilities.task_family: Operate license, upgrade, rollback, or deployment mode
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Prepare license/backups -> verify active-task preflight -> switch same mode -> verify/real-loop check; rollback restores matching bundle and data.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: License admission and release upgrade share deployment identity and same-mode safety; product skills remain a separate update decision.
capabilities.reason: Current docs define license admission and no-force/preflight boundaries.

capabilities.task_family: Install, update, and audit the customer product skill package
trigger_examples: Install Jarvis Box help in Codex
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Validate owned explicit root -> validate existing destinations -> stage four packages -> atomic replace -> byte-for-byte check; no service/binary/Company mutation.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Skill installation is independently triggered but belongs to the product operations skill because it changes only product skill payload.
capabilities.reason: Installer source currently fixes the four product package names and safe destinations.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain and deliver the public release overlay
trigger_examples: Update release notes or customer docs
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Classify public overlay vs private implementation -> edit only public owner -> update manifest/package -> audit -> branch/PR; implementation routes upstream.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Repository maintenance must not be installed into customer Agents or mixed with runtime operations.
capabilities.reason: Current contribution policy and release model define docs-only public mutation.

trigger_examples: How many merged changes had human corrections
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Provider snapshot + ordinary delivery-metrics Tasks + typed evidence; pending/none rate until complete and do not combine provider or machine totals.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Delivery measurement is an observation task with distinct population and proof, but monitoring owns read-only reporting.
capabilities.reason: Current guide distinguishes provider merge proxy, analysis pending, and retained local run metrics.

capabilities.task_family: Configure and interpret provider ingress, command, and writeback
trigger_examples: A comment command did not run
A webhook was accepted but no reply appeared
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Verified/deduplicated ingress -> exact subject Task -> Agent work -> safe artifact -> provider writeback -> terminal evidence; each stage is separately observable.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: The provider matrix is cross-cutting detail used by configuration, diagnosis, and monitoring; it should not trigger a competing general provider skill.
capabilities.reason: Current integration docs share the same ingress/writeback ownership model.
